slots.name: days before appointment
slots.sentence: Lopes’ filing argues that James’ appointment is “improper” and cites a post her office shared on X on Sept. 28, three days before her appointment was announced.

slots.name: lawsuit count
slots.sentence: In her lawsuit, Doe accuses Lopes of kissing her and sexually assaulting her without her consent.

slots.name: attorney count
slots.sentence: Attorneys for two of the seven men, including Lopes, have denied to NBC News that they sexually assaulted Doe.

slots.name: accused men count
slots.sentence: Lawyers for one of the seven men accused of raping a former Cornell University student in 2024 are seeking to block the appointment of New York Attorney General Letitia James as a special prosecutor in the case.
